slide down verb

classical

dēlābor, dēlābī

verb, third conjugation, deponent

An ancient motion verb applied to the apparatus.

Examples

  • Dēlābere!

    Slide down!composed

  • Iterum dēlābī vīs?

    Do you want to slide down again?composed

  • Prīmum ascende, deinde dēlābere.

    First climb up, then slide down.composed

  • Per tabulam deciēs dēlāpsus sum, tata!

    I went down the slide ten times, Dad!Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

Other words

  • lābor, lābī, lāpsus sum — slide

    also used · classical

    An ancient motion verb applied to the apparatus.

  • per tabulam dēlābī — go down the slide

    also used · our formation

See also slide, climb.
